_comment: Public datasets the prompt-injection benchmark downloads at run time (src/client/scripts/injection-bench.mjs). None is copied into this repository. All of them are held out: rules are never tuned on them. Licences were read from each dataset's page on the date below; see README.md.

datasets.name: deepset/prompt-injections
datasets.licence: apache-2.0 (card front matter also lists cc-by-4.0 under dataset_info)
datasets.notes: English and German. Labels follow deepset's broad definition: any attempt to steer the model off task (for example 'act as an interviewer') counts as an injection.

datasets.name: Lakera/gandalf_ignore_instructions
datasets.notes: Prompts submitted to the Gandalf game, selected by embedding similarity to 'Ignore all previous instructions' (similarity >= 0.825). All injections; the publisher notes a little label noise.

datasets.name: jackhhao/jailbreak-classification
datasets.notes: Jailbreak prompts (DAN-style persona prompts) against benign prompts, many of them benign role-play ('You are a fast-talking merchant...'). A jailbreak is not always an injection; reported on its own.

datasets.name: databricks/databricks-dolly-15k
datasets.notes: Instructions written by Databricks employees (brainstorming, QA, summarisation, classification), with their reference context when present. All benign. Share-alike licence: downloaded, never redistributed.
